name: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 60 Wall Joiner
tagline: JOINER FOR WALL EXTENDER FOR EXTENSIVE GREEN ROOF PLANTING TRAY
summary: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 60 Wall Joiner is a joiner for wall extenders designed to allow wall extenders to be joined side to side, creating a single perimeter wall around the extensive green roof plot. Wall extenders are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and slot into two adjacent wall extenders to connect them. SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 60 Wall Joiner is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 60 Wall Extender and SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 60 trays to increase the soil capacity of these trays enabling more diverse planting options.
